description: This file defines a Unity component class FollowTarget that updates the position of the game object to follow a target with a specified offset during the LateUpdate phase.

classes.name: FollowTarget
classes.description: A Unity MonoBehaviour class that updates its position to follow a target Transform with an offset during LateUpdate.

methods.name: LateUpdate
methods.description: Unity callback method called every frame after all Update methods, used here to update the position of the object to follow the target.
